desc:
🧼 Welcome to Make Soaps! A cozy soap making simulator! 🫧

🧪 Mix ingredients and craft amazing soaps!
🌸 Discover rare scents, colors, and beautiful patterns.
✨ Create unique soaps and unlock special combinations.
🔪 Cut, package, and prepare your soaps for sale.
🏪 Build your shop, upgrade your workshop, and expand your business.
👷 Hire workers to help your soap empire grow!
💎 Discover rare soaps, earn big profits, and become the ultimate soap tycoon!

🫧 Create. Collect. Sell. Build Your Empire.

👍 Like the game and join us on the journey to build the biggest soap empire!
